description: Header file defining internal API functions and constants for nl80211 netlink communication, including request handling, attribute management, and request cleanup.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_addNlAttrs
methods.description: Adds simple and nested netlink attributes to a netlink message.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmd
methods.description: Sends a netlink command, either synchronously or asynchronously, with optional callback and private data.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdSync
methods.description: Sends a synchronous netlink command and handles reply.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdSyncWithAck
methods.description: Sends a synchronous netlink command and waits for acknowledgment.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_sendCmdAsyncWithAck
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous netlink command and handles delayed acknowledgment.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_clearAllExpiredRequests
methods.description: Cleans up expired requests across all socket managers.
